title: Membrane Tension Governs Particle Wrapping-Unwrapping Transitions and Stalling
summary: Membrane wrapping controls nanoparticle uptake during endocytosis, whereas the reverse process of membrane unwrapping accompanies particle expulsion and membrane fusion events. Existing theoretical descriptions typically focus on adhesion and bending energies within the particle membrane contact region and often neglect the deformation energy of the membrane outside the contact zone. This approximation is valid only in the limit of vanishing membrane tension, where the non contact membrane assumes a catenoid like configuration with negligible bending energy.
